summary.text: Dudley Greene is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 85 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired sheriff of McDowell County, he previously worked in law enforcement in Avery County and with North Carolina Alcohol Law Enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Greene earned an associate degree in criminal justice and corrections from Maryland Community College in 1985.

His career experience includes serving as sheriff of the McDowell County Sheriff's Office, as chief detective and chief deputy with the Avery County Sheriff's Office, and as an agent with North Carolina Alcohol Law Enforcement.
Greene assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Josh Dobson.
The General Assembly's website lists him as representing Avery, McDowell, Mitchell and Yancey counties.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Appropriations, Justice and Public Safety, Emergency Management and Disaster Recovery, and House Select Committee on Helene Recovery committees and is vice chair of the Appropriations and State and Local Government committees.
